s: Dine muqtzeh beshabbat ubo k' seipim: kebar nitbaer besimman sh"ch shemmuqtzeh mechamat mius muttar, lepikak etz shettolin bo dagim leyabbesham, ap al pi shehu maus — muttar letaltelo:

Kol dabar harauy laakila beshabbat — en bo din muqtzeh, apillu im hu omed lischora, kegon temarim usheqedim ushear perot haomedim leholikam lischora lemaqom acher — muttar leekol mehem beshabbat. Vaapillu im dacha otam beyadayim milleoklo beshabbat, kegon chittim shezzeraan baqqarqa — muttar leekol mehen beshabbat im adayin lo hishrishu. Veken betzim shennetanan tachat hattarnegolet legaddel eprochim — muttar letaltelan. Veken temarim hannilqatim qodem bishshulam vekonesim otam besallim vehem mitbashshelim sham mealehem — muttar leekol mehem qodem gemar bishshulam. Veken kol mine perot shemmannichim otam bammuqtzeh leyabbesham — muttar leekol mehem qodem sheyyityabbeshu. Chutz miggerogarot vetzimmuqim, sheasur leekol mehem o letaltelan mishshehinnicham bammuqtzeh ad leachar shennityabbeshu legamre, lepi shehen masrichot benetayim veenan reuyin laakila mishshennishtahu sham meat ad sheyyityabbeshu legamre, velaken asurim beshabbat mishshum muqtzeh. Veen tzarik lomar im enan reuyin legamre, shehare hen geruin mikkol muqtzeh, shehare hen kaabanim veapar, vaapillu hazmana mibbeod yom en moelet bahem, kemo sheyyitbaer. Ella apillu im hen reuyin veenan reuyin, sheyyesh anashim sheokelim otan veyesh sheenan okelim — ap al pi ken asurim mishshum muqtzeh, shekkevan sheddacha otan beyadayim — enan olin mide dechiyyatan ad sheyyihyu reuyin legamre. Veenan domin lishar debarim sheddechaam beyadayim shemmuttarim, lepi sheap sheddechaam beyadayim — ap al pi ken lo hissiach dato mehen legamre, mah sheen ken gerogarot vetzimmuqim shehinnichan leyabbeshan, kevan shehaya yodea sheyyasrichu — hiqtza dato mehen legamre ad sheyyityabbeshu legamre veyittaqqenu heteb sheyyihyu reuyin lakkol. Veap sheakshav beshabbat nimlak leoklam — enam mukanim al yede kak, kevan shehayu muqtzim middato mittechillat hashshabbat kemo sheyyitbaer, shekkol dabar shehuqtza middaat haadam beben hashshemashot — huqtza lekol hashshabbat kullah:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bigrogarot vetzimmuqim shel yisrael, abal gerogarot vetzimmuqim shel nokri — muttarin im hem reuyin veenan reuyin, sheen din muqtzeh beshel nokri, lepi shehakkol mukan etzlo, shehannokri eno maqtzeh kelum vedato al hakkol, vekevan shehu mukan leish echad — mukan lakkol. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar talush, abal mechubbar shennitlash beshabbat, apillu hu shel nokri shettelasho leatzmo, vaapillu haya bedaat hannokri mibbeod yom litlosh perot ellu beshabbat, kegon sheshshama et hannokri omer beereb shabbat "lemachar etlosh perot ellu", vaapillu hen perot shennigmar bishshulan shehakana moelet bahem apillu beodam bimchubbar kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"ch — ap al pi ken hem asurim baakila ubetiltul mishshum gezerat perot hannosherin sheyyitbaer besimman shk"b, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h. Vedabar shehaya mechussar tzida mibbeod yom vetzad oto hannokri beshabbat, ap im haya bedato latzud beshabbat — en dato moelet kelum, sheen haddabar taluy bo, vahare hu asur beshabbat mishshum muqtzeh, shekkevan shello haya birshuto shel adam kelal — en zeh min hammukan:

Kol dabar shehaya asur betiltul beben hashshemashot ubeshabbat halak lo haddabar haggorem lo haissur, kegon dabar shehaya muqtzeh beben hashshemashot mechamat issur, dehaynu shemmechamat ezeh issur shehaya asur baakila velo haya rauy liklum beben hashshemashot haya muqtzeh veasur betiltul, ubeshabbat nistalleq mimmennu haissur venaasa rauy — ap al pi ken asur letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheddechao haadam beyadayim, dehaynu shehaadam garam lo haissur beyadayim, kegon ner shehidliqo mibbeod yom vekaba achar ben hashshemashot venishtayyer bo shemen, veshemen zeh nidcha bide adam millihyot rauy beshabbat, shekkeshehidliqo neesar lehistappeq mimmennu beshabbat mishshum issur kibbuy, laken asur lehistappeq mimmennu ap leachar shekkaba hanner venistalleq haissur, shekkevan shebbeben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat haya muqtzeh middaat haadam shehiqtza oto middato kesheggaram lo haissur — huqtza lekol hashshabbat kullah:

Veken dabar shello haya rauy beben hashshemashot mechamat atzmo velo mechamat ezeh issur venaasa rauy mishshechasheka, shehu asur betiltul kol hashshabbat kullah im nidcha bide adam millihyot rauy ben hashshemashot, kegon gerogarot vetzimmuqim shello hayu reuyin beben hashshemashot ubeshabbat nityabbeshu legamre venaasu reuyin, shekkevan shebbeben hashshemashot hayu muqtzin middaat haadam shehiqtzam middato keshehiknisan leyabbeshan — huqtzu lekol hashshabbat kullah:

Abal dabar shehaya muqtzeh beben hashshemashot beal korcho shel adam — lo huqtza lekol hashshabbat kullah, kegon dabar shehaya muqtzeh mechamat issur habba meelayv velo al yede geramat haadam, umishshechasheka nistalleq haissur — shub en bo mishshum muqtzeh, ap al pi shekkeshehiggia ben hashshemashot hissiach dato mimmennu legamre velo haya metzappeh kelal sheyyistalleq haissur beshabbat, kegon baale chayyim shehem muqtzim beshabbat mechamat issur shechita ushechatam beshabbat letzorek choleh shechala hayyom — muttar lebari leekol mehem chay ap shehissiach dato mehem keshehiggiu ben hashshemashot mishshum issur shechita, kevan shehu issur habba meelayv velo al yede geramat haadam. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Vekol zeh bedabar shehaya muqtzeh kol ben hashshemashot, abal dabar shehaya rauy beben hashshemashot apillu bemiqtzato lebad veachar kak nitqalqel beinyan shenneesar baakila o betiltul, ben shennitqalqel meelayv ben shennidcha bide adam, veachar kak chazar venittaqqen — chazar lehettero. Veen omerim mittok shehuqtza veneesar kebar bemiqtzat hashshabbat huqtza lisherit hashshabbat kullah, sheen omerim ken ella keshehuqtza bitchillat kenisat hashshabbat shehu ben hashshemashot sheaz huqtza leyom shalem, abal keshello huqtza ad achar kak, sheen kan yom shalem — lo huqtza lisherit hayyom, sheen muqtzeh lachatzi shabbat, ben beissur akila ben beissur tiltul:

Gerogarot vetzimmuqim shehayu muqtzim mippene sheenan reuyin, ukeshehiggia ben hashshemashot nityabbeshu kebar vahare hem reuyim laakila, ap al pi shello yadeu habbealim kelal beotah shaa shennityabbeshu, veachar kak noda lahem shebbeben hashshemashot kebar hayu yebeshim — muttarin baakila, shemmittechilla keshehiqtzu otan vehissichu datam mehem — lo huqtzu ella ad sheyyityabbeshu, vahare nityabbeshu vehukenu mibbeod yom:

Gerogarot vetzimmuqim sheyyabeshu qetzat beinyan shehem reuyim veenan reuyin, sheyyesh anashim sheokelin otan veyesh sheenan okelin, im hizminam laakila mibbeod yom — muttar leekol mehen beshabbat, shekkevan sheggilla dato shehen reuyin lo — yatzau mittorat muqtzeh. Veim lav — asur, shekkevan shello gilla dato — hare hen omedin behaqtzaatan shehayu muqtzin mittechilla keshello hayu reuyin leshum adam. Abal im hizmin laakila gerogarot vetzimmuqim sheenan reuyin kelal — en hazmanato moelet kelum, shehare zeh kemazmin et haeben laakila:

Kol dabar sheasur letaltelo — asur litten tachtayv keli kede sheyyippol letoko, apillu im dato lenaaro achar kak, mippene sheoser hakkeli betiltul kol zeman shehammuqtzeh betoko, venimtza mebattel keli mehekano, veasur lebattel keli mehekano apillu lepi shaa ella bimqom hepsed merubbeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman r[s]"h veras"v. Abal muttar likpot alayv keli, shebbezeh eno oser hakkeli betiltul. Ubilbad shello yigga hakkeli behammuqtzeh, sheap shemmuqtzeh muttar bingia bealma apillu beyadayv kol sheeno menaanea kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch, mikkol maqom kan shehannachat hakkeli al hammuqtzeh letzorek hammuqtzeh — asur apillu negia al yede hakkeli. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shello hizhiru chakamim shello yigga hakkeli behammuqtzeh ella keshehammuqtzeh hu dabar hammitnaanea al yede negiat hakkeli, kegon betza vekayyotze bah, shennimtza hu metaltelah al yede hakkeli, velo hittiru tiltul al yede dabar acher ella letzorek dabar hammuttar, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a:

Kol dabar haasur betiltul shehinnichu mibbeod yom al gabbe dabar hammuttar betiltul al daat sheyyishshaer munnach sham beshabbat shennaasa hahetter basis lehaissur veneesar betiltul kamohu, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"t, umishshechasheka nittal haissur meal gabbe hahetter — ap al pi ken asur letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah, kegon mitta shehinniach aleha maot mibbeod yom al daat sheyyishshaaru sham beshabbat umishshechasheka nittelu hammaot mealeha al yede nokri o qatan — asur letaltelah kol hashshabbat kullah, shemmittok shehuqtzet ben hashshemashot middaat haadam sheasaah basis leissur — huqtzet lekol hashshabbat kullah. Abal im lo hayu hammaot aleha ben hashshemashot ella leachar kak hinnichum aleha nokri o qatan, apillu hinnichum ledaat hayyisrael shehuqtzet middato milletaltelam kol zeman shehammaot aleha — ap al pi ken muttar letaltelah im nittelu hammaot mealeha, hoil velo hayeta muqtzeh beben hashshemashot. Abal beod shehammaot aleha asur letaltelah, mechamat issur tiltul hammaot shealeha. Abal muttar lehattotah ulenaarah ulehappil hammaot mealeha, uletaltelah achar kak lemaqom sheyyirtzeh. Veim tzarik limqomah — metaltelah vehen aleha, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"t bedabar shello naaset basis leissur, sheggam zo lo naaset basis leissur, hoil velo haya haissur aleha beben hashshemashot, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"h veras"v:

Vekol zeh bemitta sheenah meyuchedet lemaot, o apillu yichadah lemaot ella sheadayin lo hinniach aleha maot meolam, shebbemachashaba bilbaddah enah neeseret. Abal im yichadah lemaot, veasa bah maaseh shehinniach aleha maot paam achat apillu bechol — asur letaltelah beshabbat apillu letzorek gupah umeqomah. Veenah doma lishar kelim hammeyuchadim limleket issur shemmuttar letaltelah letzorek gupah umeqomah, mippene sheen maqpidim alehem millehishtammesh bahem tashmish acher hammuttar, abal mitta zo hammeyuchedet lemaot — adam maqpid aleha umeyached lah maqom shello letaltelah letashmish acher, vahare hi doma lemuqtzeh mechamat chesron kis sheasur letaltelo apillu letzorek gupo umeqomo, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Veyesh choleqin al zeh umattirin letaltelah letzorek gupah umeqomah kishar kelim hammeyuchadim limleket issur. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona. Velaken en letaltel kis shel maot ap al pi shehotzi hammaot mimmennu mibbeod yom, ella im ken asa bo maaseh, sheppetacho millematta vesilleqo min hayyichud:

Umikkol maqom, kis shel maot hattapur bebeged, hoil veiqqar habbeged omed lilbosh, im hotzi hammaot mishsham — yukal lilbosh habbeged, shehakkis batel etzlo. Vaapillu bakkis atzmo muttar lehanniach dabar betoko o littol mimmennu, shehare en haqtzaato ella mishshum sheadam maqpid alayv millehishtammesh bo tashmish acher, vekan anu roim sheeno maqpid alayv (vetzarik iyyun deim ken lishtere legamre):

Vaapillu im yesh maot betoko — en issur ella lilbosh et habbeged, gezera shemma yishkach veyetze bo lirshut harabbim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a vesh"g, abal muttar letaltel et habbeged. Vaapillu im hinniach et hammaot bakkis al daat sheyyishshaaru sham gam beshabbat, shennaasa hakkis basis lahem — ap al pi ken habbeged lo naasa basis lahem, hoil veen hammaot al iqqar habbeged, vedabar hammuttar hu shemmetaltel beyadayv vehaissur mittaltel immo meelayv betiltul min hatztzad, sheen bo issur kesheeno metaltel bishbil haissur ella bishbil dabar hammuttar, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a. Abal asur lehaknis yado bakkis im hinniach bo hammaot al daat sheyyishshaaru bo gam beshabbat, shennaasa hakkis basis lahem:

Vekol zeh bekis sheppiv bilbad tapur bechor shebbabbeged vehu kullo taluy, abal im kullo taluy leorko babbeged — naasa kol habbeged basis lemaot shebbakkis kemo hakkis atzmo, shehakkol echad. Vaapillu im hinniach hammaot bakkis al daat littelam mimmennu qodem hashshabbat veshakach littelam mibbeod yom, shello naasa basis lahem apillu hakkis atzmo, ap al pi ken im epshar lenaer hammaot mehakkis — tzarik lenaer mittechilla, veachar kak yetaltel habbeged lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, kemo sheim hayu hammaot al iqqar habbeged shehaya tzarik lenaer mittechilla, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"t bemaot sheal hakkar. Vaapillu bekis shekkullo taluy — lo hittiru letaltel habbeged ella keshehu tapur babbeged (sheaz hu batel etzel habbeged, veen habbeged neesar betiltul bishbilo). Abal im kis male maot qashur babbeged, kevan shehakkis hu keli bipne atzmo — (eno batel etzel habbeged, ulekak) asur letaltel (kol) habbeged im hinniach hammaot bakkis al daat sheyyishshaaru sham gam beshabbat (shennaasa hakkis basis lahem, vehabbeged lakkis haqqashur vetaluy bo). Veap im nittal hammaot mehakkis (o hakkis mehabbeged) mishshechasheka — asur letaltel (kol) habbeged kol hashshabbat kullah (kevan shennaasa basis ben hashshemashot). Veim hinnicham al daat littelam qodem hashshabbat veshakach littelam mibbeod yom — tzarik lenaer hammaot mehakkis im epshar lenaer, veachar kak yetaltel habbeged lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh im eno mitkavven bishbil hammaot kede lehatzniam, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"t. Veken im yesh maot beteba shebbetok hashshulchan — asur letaltel et hashshulchan ella bederek shennitbaer, ella im ken yesh al hashshulchan mibbeod yom dabar hammuttar betiltul, sheaz naasa hashshulchan beben hashshemashot basis leissur ulehetter, umuttar letaltelo al derek sheyyitbaer:

Kebar nitbaer besimman sh"t shekkeli shennaasa basis leissur ulehetter — muttar letaltelo. Vehu sheddabar hammuttar chashub middabar haasur, abal im dabar haasur chashub yoter middabar hammuttar — hare hahetter batel etzel haissur, veasur apillu lenaer haissur kemo sheim haya basis leissur bilbaddo, sheasur apillu lenaer kemo shennitbaer sham. Veim hahetter eno chashub etzlo mechamat rob oshro, ap al pi shehu chashub lekol haolam — eno niqra chashub, shehakkol holek achar habbealim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Vaapillu im dabar hammuttar chashub yoter, im epshar lenaer haissur bilbaddo — tzarik lenaer mittechilla, veachar kak yetaltel hakkeli im hahetter lemaqom sheyyirtzeh. Veim i epshar lenaer haissur bilbaddo mibbalade hahetter — yenaer gam hahetter immo im en hepsed beniuro, veachar kak yittol hahetter bilbaddo veyachazirennu lakkeli im yirtzeh, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veim hu beinyan sheim yenaer gam hahetter lo yukal achar kak littol hahetter bilbaddo, kegon machta sheyyesh aleha mibbeod yom eper shemmuttar letaltelo mippene sherauy lekassot bo roq o tzoa, veyesh aleh gam ken shibre etzim o pechamim haasurim betiltul, vetzarik lo letaltel haeper lemaqom acher lekassot bo, veim yenaarennu im hashshebarim vehappechamim lo yukal achar kak littol haeper lebaddo beyadayv, kegon shehem shebarim qetannim o pechamim qetannim, shei epshar littol haeper mibbiladam — muttar letaltel hammachta kemot shehi im haeper vehashshebarim vehappechamim lemaqom sheyyirtzeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshetztzarik laeper, abal im eno tzarik ella legup hammachta — lo yetaltelenna kemot shehi, ella yenaer haeper vehashshebarim vehappechamim bimqomam, hoil veen hepsed beniuram, veyittol hammachta bilbaddah:

Vekol zeh keshehaya hahetter sham im haissur mibbeod yom, shebbeben hashshemashot naasa hakkeli basis leissur ulehetter, veap im mishshechasheka nittal hahetter mishsham — lo naasa hakkeli basis az, kevan shello haya basis beben hashshemashot, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im beben hashshemashot haya alayv haissur bilbaddo umishshechasheka hunnach gam hahetter alayv — eno moil kelum, hoil ubeben hashshemashot haya basis laissur bilbaddo — neesar lekol hashshabbat kullah:

En haeper muttar betiltul ella keshehussaq mibbeod yom, abal im hussaq beshabbat — asur mishshum nolad, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ttz"ch. Veim nitareb eper shehussaq beshabbat beeper shel etmol — batel berob, im adayin lo haya nikkar meolam bipne atzmo, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:
Teba sheyyesh bah debarim hammuttarim betiltul umaot, im hammaot enan iqqar — muttar letaltelah kemot shehi al pi hattenaim shennitbaaru:
